xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5483: docs: docs site SEO, branding and config (docs.json keys, site name, Discord, Install CTA, redirects, titles, descriptions)

plan.title: docs: docs site SEO, branding and config (docs.json keys, site name, Discord, Install CTA, redirects, titles, descriptions)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The docs site build config uses legacy mint.json keys the live site ignores (no GitHub link, no Install button, no footer socials, a generated og:image), names itself 'Overdeck — The IDE for the Agent Era', uses the retired tan palette, has no Discord link, hides shipped Anywhere pages under a Vision tab, and has generic titles, out-of-range or dashed descriptions and missing redirects. mint@4.3.49 validate and broken-links both fail on main.
narratives.Proposal: Fix MDX parse and frontmatter errors so mint validate passes; replace the legacy docs.json keys with name, description, indigo colors, navbar, footer and seo (og:image https://overdeck.ai/assets/og-image.png); restructure navigation (Anywhere tab, Roadmap group, Features order) and add redirects; apply exact titles, sidebarTitles and descriptions from the PRD tables in six directory-clustered items; repoint 16 broken repo-file links at GitHub; document the rules; then paste clean validate and broken-links output into the PR body. Every check pins mint@4.3.49. Docs-only.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Primary Mintlify domain or panopticon-cli.com redirect (issue item 1, epic owner)
- Publishing, rewriting or deleting configuration/meta-repos, progressive-polyrepo, setup-wizard and the links to them (item 17, #5482 G18)
- Removing configuration/state-branch from navigation or redirecting it (#5472)
- Rewriting stale page bodies (introduction, concepts, specialists, Cloister, mission-control: #5472) or merging configuration/workspaces.mdx (#5479)
- New pages for issue pipeline, planning or Flywheel (#5468, #5469, #5470)
- Deleting the remaining duplicate-h1 body headings site-wide or running mint validate --fix
- Removing em or en dashes from body paragraphs this PR does not otherwise edit
- New lint code in scripts/lint-docs.js, including PAN-4779's optional bare-tag check
- Copying or designing an OG image file; changing background, logo or favicon
- Any change under src/, scripts/, tests/, packages/ or apps/
- A changelog.d entry

autoDecisions.summary: OG image references https://overdeck.ai/assets/og-image.png directly in seo.metatags
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the overdeck.ai card; the live URL returns a 1200x630 PNG and stays current with the site. Copying a binary would go stale, and the local landing repo holds an unpushed newer card.
The issue names the quickstart as the better target; a relative path works on every docs domain and under mint dev.

autoDecisions.summary: Colors primary #4f46e5, light #818cf8, dark #4f46e5; background unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Style guide section 19 brand mark colors; Mintlify uses light as the dark-mode primary and #818cf8 reads better on dark. The issue asks only for the palette.

autoDecisions.summary: Vision tab renamed Anywhere with Overdeck Anywhere and Anywhere CLI groups; vision and template-conversations move to a Roadmap group in Reference
autoDecisions.rationale: Item 7 offers the rename; the Roadmap group also settles item 18 without deleting the proposal page.

autoDecisions.summary: Features ordered now from existing pages; pipeline, planning and Flywheel pages are inserted by #5468, #5469, #5470
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue says do what you can now; those pages do not exist yet.

autoDecisions.summary: state-branch: only the description dash is fixed here
autoDecisions.rationale: #5472 explicitly owns its nav removal and redirect; item 16's redirect is conditional on that.
G18 decides whether the three unpublished pages are published, rewritten or deleted; fixing the links first would pre-empt that.

autoDecisions.summary: Body H1 deleted on every page whose frontmatter this PR edits, except state-branch; no site-wide mint validate --fix
autoDecisions.rationale: Retitled pages would show a contradicting second H1; a site-wide fix touches about 80 files that sibling issues edit in parallel.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Remove dashes from bodies you edit' applied to every line this PR adds or modifies, checked on the scoped diff
autoDecisions.rationale: About 549 dashes sit in untouched paragraphs of pages sibling issues are rewriting; whole-body de-dashing here would conflict with them.

autoDecisions.summary: The 16 broken links are fixed here by pointing them at GitHub blob URLs
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's new 'Every PR' section requires a clean mint broken-links result in the PR body; a probe showed this makes it exit 0.

autoDecisions.summary: No new lint code; checks are one-line commands
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the PR docs-only; a probed bare-tag heuristic gave 16 false positives on wrapped inline code.
mint --version prints unknown and results differ across versions (PAN-4779 saw a different error set on mint@4).

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only frontmatter and config edits across about 40 small files. Each .mdx file changes 1 to 10 lines, and every file belongs to exactly one item. The projected-surface lint counts each dir/file.mdx as its own subsystem. The issue is already one child of epic #5467, so splitting it further would only add coordination over docs.json and the PR-evidence step.

node --input-type=module -e 'import {collectPublishedPages} from "./scripts/lint-docs.js";import {parse} from "yaml";import {readFileSync} from "fs";const pages=collectPublishedPages(JSON.parse(readFileSync("docs.json","utf8")));for(const p of pages){const d=parse(readFileSync(p+".mdx","utf8").match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---/)[1]);const n=(d.description||"").length;if(n<50||n>160||/[\u2013\u2014]/.test([d.title,d.sidebarTitle,d.description].join(" ")))throw new Error(p+" "+n)}console.log(pages.length,"site-ok")'

npx -y mint@4.3.49 validate --format json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);if(!r.passed)throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r.summary));console.log("validate-ok",JSON.stringify(r.summary))})'
npx -y mint@4.3.49 broken-links 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -F 'no broken links found'

narrative.Action: Follow PRD Work item 13 after every other item is done: make the allow-empty Item trailer commit and push it, run the scoped diff dash check, the whole-site frontmatter check, mint@4.3.49 validate and broken-links on that commit, write a PR body file with a summary, Closes #5483, Refs #4779 and a '## Mintlify checks' section holding both commands and their clean output, open the PR with gh pr create (or gh pr edit if one exists), run pan task done for the item and its ACs, then run pan done.
